Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Vin Baker?

Vin Baker is 54 years old.

Where was Vin Baker born?

Vin Baker was born in Lake Wales, Florida.

When was Vin Baker born?

Vin Baker was born on November 23, 1971.

How tall is Vin Baker?

Vin Baker is 6-11 (211 cm) tall.

How much did Vin Baker weigh when playing?

Vin Baker weighed 232 lbs (105 kg) when playing.

Is Vin Baker in the Hall of Fame?

Vin Baker is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Vin Baker drafted?

Vin Baker was drafted by Milwaukee Bucks, 1st round (8th pick, 8th overall), 1993 NBA Draft.

What position did Vin Baker play?

Power Forward and Center.

When did Vin Baker retire?

Vin Baker last played in 2006.

What is Vin Baker's net worth?

Vin Baker made at least $97,390,894 playing professional basketball.

How much did Vin Baker make?

Vin Baker made $13,500,000 in 2004.

What did Vin Baker average?

Vin Baker averaged 15.0 points, 7.4 rebounds, and 1.9 assists per game.

How many rings does Vin Baker have?

Vin Baker won 0 championships.

What schools did Vin Baker attend?

Vin Baker attended Old Saybrook in Old Saybrook, Connecticut and University of Hartford.

What are Vin Baker's nicknames?

Vinnie, Shake and Bake are nicknames for Vin Baker.
